reference_centres.setting: not a registration: the OCT translated so that the centres of the two image boxes coincide, header orientation kept

octreg.start: own orientation search (8,000 rotations) inside the MRI crop

ants_com.setting: antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t a: rigid then affine, Mattes MI, the script's large-image schedule, no mask

ants_com_fov.setting: as ants_com, with the OCT field-of-view (FOV) mask

ants_antsai.setting: antsAI rigid rotation search (Mattes MI, 0.15 mm copies), then the stages of ants_com

elastix_center.setting: model-zoo Parameters_Rigid then Parameters_Affine (AdvancedMattesMutualInformation), no mask

elastix_cog_fov.setting: as elastix_center, with the OCT FOV mask

flirt_search_x10.setting: normmi, -dof 6 then -dof 12 -nosearch, both headers scaled x10 because FLIRT's schedule resamples the images to fixed voxel sizes in mm (an adaptation FSL does not document)
flirt_search_x10.start: FLIRT default rotation search (±90°, coarse 60°, fine 18°)

flirt_search_native.setting: normmi, -dof 6 then -dof 12, as documented, on the unscaled 0.08 mm headers

greedy_centers_fov.setting: as greedy_centers, with the OCT FOV as moving mask

mri_coreg_default.start: volume centres + the default brute-force search

mri_robust_register_noinit_rigid_only.setting: --cost NMI, the rigid step only: the affine step found no overlap of the two images and made no iteration

niftyreg_center.setting: defaults: symmetric block matching, rigid then affine

niftyreg_center_fov.setting: as niftyreg_center with -fmask (OCT FOV). This version ignores the mask, and the output equals niftyreg_center

synthmorph_affine.setting: register -m affine as documented. A model of 1 mm whole-brain images, run on a 0.08 mm block
